newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London creep up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London creep up in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares inched higher in sleepy trade on Thursday, buoyed by a stronger FTSE-100 index and gains on Wall Street.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index finished the day up 73.26 points, or 0.57 percent, at 12,919.82.

"It's been a very quiet day, there hasn't been much trade going on apart from in Hong Kong Bank. The market has really moved up in sympathy with the FTSE, Wall Street and the long bond," one trader said.
Investors are currently languishing in holiday mood and are reluctant to take positions ahead of the year-end, dealers said.
